notes.title: Cheats Available During Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

While we continue working on bug fixes, we know some of you are eager to progress through the game. As gamers ourselves, we understand that frustrating feeling when you're immersed in the game but hit a roadblock.

To help you continue your journey, [b]we're enabling cheat codes that will allow you to bypass any problematic missions or sections.[/b] This doesn't mean we've stopped working on proper fixes – we're still committed to resolving all issues. We simply want to give you options to keep playing while we perfect the experience.

[b]😉 PSA: These cheats are for bugs, not for fun! Don't spoil your own experience – save them for when something's actually broken! 😉[/b]

[h3]Available Cheat Codes[/h3]
Once activated, use these keyboard shortcuts:

7 - Hide UI (Note: This makes the UI unresponsive until game restart, but great for screenshots)
8 - Add 20 prestige points
9 - Add $1,000
0 - Skip current mission step

[h3]How to Enable Cheats[/h3]
1. Right-click on the game in your Steam Library
2. Select "Properties"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39136549/4447255ae3ded647c91bedef96bfbe6a36a288f3.png[/img]
3. In the Launch Options field, type: -cheats
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39136549/04369846a2cdca9837a66b6c3a948d65d5ffb0da.png[/img]
4. Launch the game and use the cheat codes above

We appreciate your patience as we work to deliver the smooth experience you deserve. 

Thank you for your continued support!

- The Underground Garage Team

Please send us your crash logs so we can investigate the issue:
[list]
    [*]After a crash, press CTRL + V to paste the logs here if prompted.
    [*]Or manually find them at: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\UndergroundGarage\Saved\Crashes
[/list]

[h3]Live Support[/h3]
You can also reach out to us via Live Chat or on our Discord — we’re always happy to assist!
Discord - https://discord.gg/beardedbrothers
Live Chat - https://chat.socialintents.com/c/shs-chat-support

[h3]Crash Prevention Tips[/h3]
[h3]Verify Game Files[/h3]
Corrupted or incomplete game files can cause crashes. To verify:
[list]
    [*]Open Steam
    [*]Right-click on Underground Garage > Properties
    [*]Go to the Local Files tab and select Verify Integrity of Game Files
[/list]
[h3]Drivers Update[/h3]
To ensure your game is running smoothly, please make sure your drivers are up to date:

[b]AMD Drivers:[/b] https://www.amd.com/en/support/download/drivers.html 
[b]Nvidia GeForce:[/b] https://www.nvidia.com/en-gb/geforce/geforce-experience/ 

For Nvidia you also have to make sure you have the Game Ready Drivers.

notes.title: Major Update + 43% OFF!
notes.notes:
Hello Underground Garage fans!

The Wait is Over – [b]Our Biggest Update is Here![/b]

To celebrate, [b]Underground Garage is 43% OFF—our biggest discount ever[/b], available for a limited time. 

We also have brand new trailer:
[previewyoutube=pwYjc_dl4wE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]New Bundle Alert![/b][/h3]
We’ve also teamed up with JDM: Japanese Drift Masters in a new adrenaline-fueled bundle!
Hit the streets with style and precision in [b]Underground Garage + JDM: Japanese Drift Master[/b]. From customizing machines to conquering mountain roads—this is where car culture comes alive.
Enjoy a sweet discount and double the drifting fun!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54578/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master_x_Underground_Garage/

We’re excited to release the biggest update Underground Garage has seen so far—built with your feedback and powered by your continued support. This one’s all about you and for YOU <3.

Thanks for being part of the journey—leaving us feedback in the Steam forums, joining our beta tests, and helping us make the game better every step of the way. We couldn’t have done it without you.

[h3]⚠️ [b]IMPORTANT![/b]⚠️[/h3]
In this version, we've introduced extensive changes to improve stability, performance, enable modding, and add new vehicles. [b]Unfortunately, this comes with compatibility issues for your old save files. You can still load them and will retain your prestige, money, progress, and cars - but these will be the new versions of the vehicles, not your exact same cars, as we've completely rebuilt the vehicle handling code from the ground up.[/b]

[b]We recommend starting fresh, as playing on old saves may cause bugs and issues.[/b]
We apologize for the inconvenience - we hope you understand that this is an Early Access game, and based on your feedback, we've completely overhauled the entire vehicle system. This has also resulted in much improved driving mechanics and tuning options.

Happy tuning! 
~ The Underground Garage Team

notes.title: Big Update - New Driving, Fixes and 25% OFF!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We’re excited to bring you a huge update packed with i[b]mprovements and fixes[/b], all based on the feedback you’ve shared with us. This includes a [b]complete overhaul of driving physics[/b], as well as numerous fixes to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay.

To celebrate this milestone, [b]Underground Garage is now 25% off for a limited time![/b]

[previewyoutube=QPqzllqhnj0;full][/previewyoutube]

Let’s break down the highlights of this update:

[b]Major Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced driving physics: improved drifting control, better wheel curves, scaled speed
[*] Fixed various keybinding issues including handbrake/phone controls and inventory sell part binding
[*] Added ultra-high speed counter steering multiplier (200-350 km/h)
[*] Widened tire friction range with Forza-like steering sensitivity
[*] Improved gear changing mechanics and torque application
[/list]

[b]Notable Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Quest “Rise from the Ashes” is now fixed
[*] Multiple race-related fixes (blocking after race, mechanic mode, race panel visibility)
[*] Fixed several UI and camera issues in mechanic/painting modes
[*] Improved collision detection in garage
[*] Fixed car lift functionality after save/load
[*] Resolved various gamepad-related issues
[/list]

[b]Technical Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized grid spawn system
[*] Fixed car inputs cache on exit driving state
[*] Improved landscape collision detection
[*] Various performance and stability updates
[/list]

As always, your feedback has been instrumental in shaping Underground Garage, and we’re committed to building the best experience possible as we continue through Early Access. Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts, ideas, and bug reports with us — your input helps us grow and improve the game <3 

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. You’re the reason we keep pushing to make Underground Garage even better.

Enjoy the update and we’ll see you on the streets!

All the best,
The Underground Garage Team

notes.title: Our Upcoming Update and Future Plans
notes.notes:
Hello Mechanics,

We hope you’re enjoying your time in the Underground Garage! We’ve been closely following your feedback, and it’s clear how passionate you are about making this game the best it can be. 

With that in mind, we’ve decided to shift our focus towards delivering a bigger and more comprehensive update around mid-December. This update is designed to address many of the concerns you’ve raised while bringing exciting new features to the game.


[h2]Here’s what you can expect in December Update:[/h2]

[b]Revamped Physics and New Driving Routes:[/b] We’re overhauling the game’s physics to make driving feel smoother, more responsive, and immersive. Plus, we’re adding fresh routes to test your skills on the streets.

[b]Save System Fixes:[/b] We’re addressing issues with the save system that disrupt gameplay flow. No more frustrating moments when your progress doesn’t stick.

[b]Optimization Improvements:[/b] One major focus is tackling performance issues, especially for players with large garages. Say goodbye to crashes when you collect too many cars!

[b]Car Hierarchy Enhancements:[/b] We’re refining how vehicles are organized and displayed, making it easier to manage your fleet.

[b]Steam Deck Compatibility:[/b] Underground Garage on the go! We’re adding full compatibility for the Steam Deck.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39136549/e79473ee3f0637092eac7b306e95754d57db3e5f.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes and QoL Improvements:[/b] From small glitches to user interface tweaks, we’re making a ton of small adjustments to enhance the overall experience.

[b]Keybinding Options:[/b] We know how important control customization is, so we’re adding the ability to rearrange your buttons to suit your playstyle.

[b]Full Racing with AI:[/b] You’ll soon be able to take part in full-fledged races against AI opponents

[b]New Story Missions:[/b] Dive deeper into the underground racing scene with fresh, high-stakes missions that expand the game’s narrative.

[b]New Cars:[/b] Keep an eye out for new vehicles to customize and race. There’s more variety coming to your garage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39136549/6a22b14b3cf28fb9249519bb4727ce5ca554e89e.png[/img]

This update will be a big step forward, and we can’t wait to share it with you. We’re committed to making Underground Garage the ultimate experience for car enthusiasts and underground racers alike.

Stay tuned for more details as we get closer to mid-December, and as always, thank you for your support and feedback—it drives everything we do.

See you in the Garage!

The Underground Garage Team

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Gearheads![/b]

First off, we want to give a massive shoutout to every one of you in the Underground Garage community! Thank you for your trust, patience, and all the feedback you've given us during this Early Access journey. Your support has been the fuel that's driving us forward and helping make this game as sharp as a well-tuned engine.

Here’s a breakdown of what’s new under the hood:

[b]Quest Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Quest 9 Adjustment: We heard that some of you had issues with Quest 9 not advancing after buying new cars. We’ve streamlined the quest, and for anyone stuck, it will now auto-complete once you return to the garage, keeping you on the fast track.
[/list]

[b]Workbench & Repair Overhaul:[/b]
[list]
[*]     Damage and Repair Strategy: We’ve tweaked how procedural damage works so repairs are more strategic. Key parts like nitro and neons are now untouchable by damage, letting you focus on essentials.
[*]     Cost of Repairs: Repairs will now require cash and restore partial durability, letting you profit by fixing and flipping parts for a bit of extra hustle.
[*]     Increased Repair Rewards: Repair missions now pay better, giving you even more reason to jump into the action.
[/list]

[b]General Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Junkyard Collision Fix: Fixed those pesky collision issues for cars bought at the junkyard.
[*] UI Improvements: Enhanced onboarding, early access info, and broken parts display for a smoother experience.
[*] Damage System Overhaul: We fine-tuned the damage system to make it more precise and realistic.
[*] Car Entry Requirements: To add more depth, you’ll now need all vital parts at or above 70% condition before heading out. This makes your prep work count even more.
[/list]

[b]Balance Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve made final balancing adjustments to keep the gameplay flow and your strategic decisions tight and rewarding.
[/list]

This is just the beginning—next up, we’ll be tackling more bugs, adjusting the build of our cars for realism, refining physics, and diving deeper into the story that powers Underground Garage. Your feedback has made this possible, and we’re thrilled to be on this ride together, achieving something special.

Thanks for helping us hit new gears! Keep the feedback coming, and we’ll keep making this garage the best place for any true mechanic and street racer.

Stay sharp and keep wrenching!

Hello everyone!

The latest update for "Underground Garage" Alpha on Steam, build 4622, introduces a variety of new features and improvements:

[b]1. Mechanic Mode:[/b]
   - Fully operational mechanic mode allows players to change parts, each influencing driving physics.

   - The entire planned district is accessible to players, though still under refinement.
   - NPCs are visible and interactive within the map.

[b]4. Driving Mechanics:[/b]
   - Driving physics are simcade-style, dependent on the car parts' statistics.

[b]5. Quests:[/b]
   - A Tutorial quest is fully functional.
   - Procedurally generated quests are available after completing the Tutorial, focusing on car statistic tuning, accessible through the Journal (button 'J').
   - Time Trial Race, currently in testing, is available near the Deb garage.

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
   - Occasional incorrect driving behavior, as it is still being polished.
   - Some car elements cannot be rendered correctly.

[b]Current Priorities:[/b]
   - Resolving issues with car traffic which is currently too bug-ridden.
   - Optimization efforts to ensure stability at 30fps on gaming computers at Epic quality settings.

notes.title: Development Diary #34 - Changes and car update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We come to you with a brand new update. Today we will talk a little more about Underground Garage as a whole and what our plans are for the future. 

We've had many conversations with publishers. Each time we've received the same feedback, UG focuses too much on the racing part. This makes it look like competition to AAA titles like NFS or Forza Horizon. 

Therefore, Underground Garage will undergo changes. We are moving away from the racing part, driving will, of course, remain, but it will be in the form of a free ride and test drive. 

[b]We want to focus on what has always been most important and what should be the essence of UG - being a mechanic.[/b] We want the heart of our game to be managing a workshop, tuning cars, and repairing them. Our models are super detailed, so we want you to spend as much time as possible looking under the hood ;) 

We also plan to develop the storyline strongly and provide you with a single-player campaign for several hours of fun!

We won't lie; we're super excited about all of this! And you? Don't forget to share your opinion with us. 

And as always, we have a graphic update for you from our reliable Mateusz:

notes.title: Dev Diary #19 Bug fixes, game improvements, roadmap, new screenshots!
notes.notes:
Hey!

Last weeks were quieter, but we're back with the noise :D

I don't know if you guys know, but making a game is a constant struggle for every little element to be as cool as possible... And working. We wanted to release the demo already in May, now we hope to do it in June. There's a lot to look forward to! 

And next week, for those of you who like to play products that don't quite work, we will announce another call for alpha tests. Start having fun :)

In recent weeks, apart from working on fixing bugs and improving the game, we were also creating our first NPC (pic rel - motion capture in Bones.studio), preparing the paint shop, the sticker system and the tuning system. And we played the game hundreds of times. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39136549/30fe9e9f21a5f4a1beac17d4fe4892a39fd78182.jpg[/img]

The upcoming plan looks like this:
1. next week - announce alpha testing and send out keys.
2. end of the month - finishing and publishing a playable demo. 

For those who want to stay as alpha testers we will prepare a separate calendar of closed tests :)

Apart from the demo, we are also working on the trailer and made some new screenshots. Enjoy! :D
